instructions: GENUINELY BLIND RUN - no U-Proof or other client knowledge. You are INDEPENDENT of Agents 01-05 and must actively challenge their prior work. Review: does content_pack actually fix the phone/address inconsistency with ONE authoritative block, or does it silently repeat the split? Does build_plan visibly ticket every issue research_report raised (contact mismatch, duplicated services list, Hertex spelling, thin Leather Couches/Gallery content)? Did design_system's 'no real vision input' limitation get carried forward honestly? Any invented facts (services, locations, awards, certifications) not traceable to real evidence? Produce qa_report@1 with concrete P0-P3 defects and an honest readyForHumanReview verdict - do not default to true. This is a review of PLANNING ARTIFACTS ONLY, no live site re-tested in this pass. IMPORTANT OUTPUT FORMAT NOTE: return each field as a plain JSON array of strings/objects directly as the tool-call argument value. Do not emit any XML-style <parameter name=...> tags anywhere in your output, including inside string or array values - output must be pure JSON values with no embedded markup of any kind.
